segments.name: Engine Products
segments.description: Produces advanced jet engine and industrial gas turbine components for aerospace and defense applications.
segments.evidence: Engine Products utilizes advanced designs and techniques to support next-generation engine programs and produces components primarily for aircraft engines and industrial gas turbines, including airfoils and seamless rolled rings.

segments.name: Fastening Systems
segments.description: Produces highly engineered aerospace, industrial and commercial transportation fastening systems and installation tools.
segments.evidence: Fastening Systems produces aerospace and industrial fastening systems as well as commercial transportation fasteners and installation tools.

segments.name: Engineered Structures
segments.description: Produces titanium and aluminum engineered structural components for aerospace and defense airframes and engines.
segments.evidence: Engineered Structures produces titanium ingots and mill products for aerospace and defense applications and is vertically integrated to produce titanium forgings, titanium extrusions, and machining services for airframe, wing, aero-engine, and landing gear components.

segments.name: Forged Wheels
segments.description: Manufactures lightweight forged aluminum wheels for commercial trucks, buses and trailers.
segments.evidence: Forged Wheels manufactures lightweight, high-strength forged aluminum wheels for trucks, buses, and trailers, serving the global transportation market.

revenueModel.text: Customers including aerospace manufacturers, defense contractors, and transportation companies purchase products directly or through distributors.

changes.text: In 2020, the Arconic Inc. Separation Transaction separated the company into Howmet and Arconic Corporation, with Howmet retaining Engine Products, Fastening Systems, Engineered Structures, and Forged Wheels.
changes.evidence: On April 1, 2020, Arconic Inc. separated its businesses (the "Arconic Inc. Separation Transaction") into two independent, publicly traded companies: Howmet Aerospace Inc. (the new name for Arconic Inc.) and Arconic Corporation.

changes.text: In 2025, the company combined revenue disclosure for industrial gas turbine and oil and gas end markets into Gas Turbines, eliminating the Industrial & Other end market disclosure.
changes.evidence: In the fourth quarter 2025, the Company combined the revenue disclosure for the industrial gas turbine and oil & gas end markets into Gas Turbines. As a result of this change, the Company will no longer disclose the Industrial & Other end market.
